scope: 独立架构审查：实际PG角色正向执行反例；不是产品端到端测试

counterexamples.name: 普通worker不能执行acquire所要求的bid行锁
counterexamples.stderr:
ERROR:  42501: permission denied for table bids
LOCATION:  aclcheck_error, aclchk.c:2843
counterexamples.sql: BEGIN; SET LOCAL ROLE tender_worker; SELECT id FROM design.bids WHERE id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000010' FOR UPDATE; COMMIT;

counterexamples.name: 研究worker也不能执行统一bid行锁
counterexamples.stderr:
ERROR:  42501: permission denied for table bids
LOCATION:  aclcheck_error, aclchk.c:2843
counterexamples.sql: BEGIN; SET LOCAL ROLE tender_research_worker; SELECT id FROM design.bids WHERE id='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000010' FOR UPDATE; COMMIT;

counterexamples.name: 研究worker不能写费用预留所需model_calls
counterexamples.stderr:
ERROR:  42501: permission denied for table model_calls
LOCATION:  aclcheck_error, aclchk.c:2843
counterexamples.sql: BEGIN; SET LOCAL ROLE tender_research_worker; INSERT INTO design.model_calls(id,operation_id,logical_call_key,attempt_no,request_digest,profile_digest,state) SELECT NULL::uuid,NULL::uuid,'fixture',1,repeat('a',64)::design.sha256,repeat('b',64)::design.sha256,'reserved' WHERE false; COMMIT;

counterexamples.name: 研究worker不能读取阶段收据
counterexamples.stderr:
ERROR:  42501: permission denied for table step_receipts
LOCATION:  aclcheck_error, aclchk.c:2843
counterexamples.sql: BEGIN; SET LOCAL ROLE tender_research_worker; SELECT * FROM design.step_receipts LIMIT 0; COMMIT;

counterexamples.name: 普通worker不能反过来代理研究费用预留
counterexamples.stderr:
ERROR:  42501: permission denied for function reserve_research_fee
LOCATION:  aclcheck_error, aclchk.c:2843
counterexamples.sql: BEGIN; SET LOCAL ROLE tender_worker; SELECT design.reserve_research_fee('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000099',1); COMMIT;
